method.inspiration: BLB (arXiv:2508.19525); independent, isolated PLLM probe, not an implementation of BLB
method.backend: TenSEAL CKKS, poly modulus degree 8192, 4096 slots, coefficient bits 60/40/40/60, scale 2^40
method.sample: one ciphertext of public synthetic values in [-0.5,0.5] with server-side encrypted affine 0.75*x+0.125, decrypted and checked against plaintext
method.counting: pack each prefill layer gate over all 39 rows, but each autoregressive decode row separately; use smallest of three observed ciphertext sizes for every chunk, charge only one outbound gate ciphertext per chunk

conclusion: For this sampled CKKS-to-protected-SiLU boundary, gate ciphertext output alone exceeds the matched prepared covered-body control at both lengths. The current prepared schedule already groups Q/K/V and gate/up projections and has no HE/MPC conversions or MPC truncation for BLB to eliminate. These samples do not veto BLB's secure conversion, optimized packing, approximate nonlinear decomposition, or other HE implementations.
unmeasured: CKKS/MPC conversion, masking and feedback, attention, two-way traffic, provider compute, real Qwen numeric fidelity, cold keys and complete wire
